summary: Computes the address of an indexed element within a structure. Reads the base pointer stored at a1+8, dereferences it at +12 to obtain an array base, reads a 16-bit index from the table at a1 + 2*a2, and returns array_base + 48*index. A pure calculation with no guards, globals, or callees; used by sub_4DE610 and sub_4DF110.

local_names.a1: struct holding a pointer field at +8 and a 16-bit index table indexed by a2
local_names.a2: element index selecting a 16-bit entry in the table at a1

operations.description: Read the 16-bit index entry at a1 + 2*a2 (2-byte table stride).
Multiply the 16-bit index by 48 to form the byte offset within the element array.
Dereference the pointer at a1+8 and read the element-array base pointer stored at the result + 12.
Return the element-array base plus 48*index, i.e. the address of the indexed element.
Invoked by sub_4DE610 (0x004DE610) and sub_4DF110 (0x004DF110) to resolve an indexed struct element address.

unresolved: The element stride 48 implies an array of fixed-size records, but the record layout is not evidenced by the packet.
The purpose of the base pointer double-dereference (a1+8 then +12) and the meaning of the 16-bit index table are not evidenced.
The owning class is unknown; packet marks owner as UnknownObject/UNKNOWN.
